scope: R1-002 isolated IAM start config; static validate only, no backend launch
passwordPolicy: IAM_PERSISTENCE_PASSWORD + replay/fingerprint secrets injected into child env only at start; never CLI/output/evidence

tls.entry: https://127.0.0.1:<TLS_PORT>/api/v1/auth/register (TLS_PORT pending owner input; default HTTP :18087 must NOT be used as TLS evidence)
tls.secureCookie: refresh-cookie-secure=true (application.yaml default; local profile false is NOT acceptance)
tls.note: JWT RSA signing key (IAM_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE) is not a TLS server certificate

pep403.expect: 403 learning access is not granted (never 401/404/503 substitute)

effectiveCheck: READY 后子进程 env 逐键核对上述白名单（密钥类仅核存在性，不输出值）+ /actuator/health/readiness + 公开 GET
